name: Sense CMS Social Publishing
author: QUANT Software House Limited
description: Review-first publishing of Sense CMS posts through independently installed social network connectors, with an idempotent queue, retries and delivery history.

changelog.summary: Bind every queued provider delivery to a stable revision key for broker-side idempotency.
Expose provider-specific message limits and safely persist rotated social credentials.
Support multiple independently selected social destinations per provider, post and delivery history.
Align the Social Publishing workspace, delivery overview and provider cards with the Sense CMS administration design system.
Run the delivery worker through the canonical installation runtime and private workspace configuration.
Provider-neutral post targets, encrypted connections, idempotent delivery queue, editor controls and worker.
